answer: Delivery-commitment bond: each identity locks 70 credit and files one commitment, one unique pearl. The pearl is due before the tide turns. A gale audit sweeps random commitments each epoch and recomputes each pearl; a missing or rented pearl burns the 70 bond plus a 45 fee. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 115 = 115,000 for a 40,000 pool, a 75,000 net loss. An honest agent files one pearl, pays 45 once, keeps its full share.
